final: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, examination_count * 1.0 / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_fraction FROM counts) SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, fraction - average_fraction AS excess FROM shares WHERE fraction > average_fraction ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
